_comment: Scaffolded from matrix.json. Replace every "TODO: …" before merging. See HOW_TO_EDIT.md and lexical matrix v3.
_matrixAnalyse: The data volume is limited but the conversion signal is clear and consistent. 'Web developer' (19 clk, CVR 10.5% and 12 clk, CVR 8.3%) and 'full stack developer' (6 clk, CVR 16.7% and 2 clk, CVR 25.0%) are the core converters. 'Web development classes' (16 clk, CVR 12.5%) confirms the structured training intent. Pattern B : 'javascript' (4 clk, CVR 0%) — technology-first searches do not convert, suggesting the audience starts with the role (web developer) not the stack. The page should lead with the career outcome and introduce technologies as the path, not the headline.
